audience: salons that take online bookings in BKG

useCases.title: See tomorrow's bookings
useCases.text: List the bookings in a time range, filtered by staff or service. Open one for its time, service and status.

useCases.title: Find an open time for a service
useCases.text: Check the staff hours. Then search the open times for a service over up to 14 days.

useCases.title: Look up a client's history
useCases.text: Search clients by name, e-mail or phone. Then list the bookings of that client.

useCases.title: Book or cancel an appointment
useCases.text: Book a client into an open time. Cancel a booking under the salon's cancellation terms.
